name_reason: Compliant with fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention. Descriptor accurately reflects behaviour: it initializes (populates) a runtime-char slot in the MENU-party roster (template_chars) from the static char_base + char_growth tables. No Ghidra address residue in the name; no domain ID to preserve in the name itself.
purpose: Populate a new menu-party (template_chars) roster slot for a permanently-joining character from the static char_base + char_growth tables, then recompute equip-adjusted aggregates and bump the member count.
logic_summary: Computes slot_addr = menu_party_roster_buffer_ptr + menu_party_member_count*0x50. Fetches base = fd2_get_char_base_entry(char_id) and growth = fd2_get_char_growth_entry(char_id). level = base[2]. total_HP = base[+3](i16) + growth[6]*(level-1); total_MP = base[+5](i16) + growth[8]*(level-1). Per-level AP/DP/DX = base[+0x12/+0x14/+0x16] + growth[0/2/4]*level. Writes slot bytes: +5 flags=0, +6 team=2 (player), +7/+8 char_id, +9=0, +A=0x40 / +B=base[+0xC] (primary item), +C=0x40 / +D=base[+0xD] (secondary item); a 4-iter loop fills inventory slots +E..+15 (flag 0x80 if base item == 0xFF else 0, id = base[+0xE+i]); +16/+18 = 0x80 (two empty extra slots); memmove 4 bytes base[+8..+0xB] -> +1A (spell bitmap); +1E=0; +1F/+20 = base[+0]/base[+1] (class identity bytes); +21 = level; memset 6 bytes 0 at +22 (status flags); +31 = 0xFF (pickup kind = none); +37 = AP, +39 = DP, +3B = base[+7] (magic resist), +3C = 0 (movement order = player default), +3E = DX; +40/+42 = total_HP (cur/max), +44/+46 = total_MP (cur/max). Slot bytes +0..+4 (pos/sprite_state) are NOT written here (caller seeds them). Tail: fd2_recompute_runtime_char_total_stats(menu_party_member_count) applies equipment deltas, then menu_party_member_count++.

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: Character ID (game domain 00h-D6h) selecting the char_base and char_growth table entries to populate the slot from; also stored into slot bytes +7 and +8. Stack-based arg read from [ESP+0x34]; caller does ADD ESP,4 cleanup (cdecl).
params.reason: Live Ghidra name is the generic placeholder param_1 (Ghidra flags needs_rename). It is a character ID, so char_id is the precise name; src already uses char_id. Rename is recorded only and applied in Stage 2.

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effects: writes one menu-party roster slot, increments data_fd2_shared_menu_party_member_count, and triggers stat recompute for that slot.

notes: src comment block (btl_init.c lines 221-239) is already concise, accurate, ASCII, and free of process/phase narration; it correctly states both stat formulas, the untouched +0..+4 bytes, the slot location, and the recompute+increment tail -> comment_verdict=keep. Ghidra plate is much more detailed (full byte-by-byte layout) but consistent with src and the body, so plate left untouched (ghidra_plate_action=none). 20 callers: chapter_NN_end recruit-growth paths, chapter_01_init (4 calls), chapter_25_end (runtime-only init), and 4 chapter_event_handler reinforcement/dialog handlers; all are 1-arg cdecl call sites (ADD ESP,4) consistent with the signature. Verified fd2_init_runtime_char_for_battle (sibling at 0x10C50) is the battle-runtime_char_array counterpart, confirming this function's MENU-party scope. NO logic change made (analysis-only; comment kept). Parameter rename param_1 -> char_id recorded for Stage 2 only.
